name: contendoor
description: Work with your team's video content, files, notes, ideas, tasks and production stages in Contendoor.

interface.longDescription:
Contendoor is the AI-native workspace behind the content of small businesses, creators and solo founders: content ideas, video footage and photos, the editing board, finished cuts, notes, to-dos and publishing, all in one place.

Connect it to ChatGPT and it works inside that workspace with you, with your brand context already there.

What ChatGPT can do with Contendoor:

- Plan: read your Brand profile, get content ideas grounded in it, and turn an idea into a concept with its own Raw folder holding the assets.

- Organize media: list Raw and Final folders, find files by plain-language search, AI label, summary or transcript, move files between folders, rename them and get download links. All file types and formats are accepted.

- Save files: Save supported chat attachments or files from links into your workspace.

- Produce: create and edit notes with full, rich-text editing capabilities (scripts, hooks, shot lists, planners), move concepts along the editing board from planned to done, and keep the to-do list. Read available transcripts of supported voice memos, audio and video.

- Review: read and leave comments on a file, timestamped on a video or pinned to a spot in the frame.

- Publish: post a finished video, photo or text post to your connected Instagram, Facebook, Threads, TikTok, X, LinkedIn or YouTube Shorts, using the formats each platform supports. Posts can be published now or scheduled, with captions you write or Contendoor’s AI writes; see the queue and how published posts performed.



Sign in with your Contendoor account and connect it through OAuth so ChatGPT can act as a named agent in your workspace and work within your existing workspace permissions.
